text: In my youth I walked alone through the fields of Lincolnshire, counting the hours by the shadow on the wall. Now my hands are old, and still I wonder at the quiet order of the world.

dryraspy.instruct: An elderly English man in his eighties, speaking with a refined, traditional British English accent, unhurried, calm and reflective, like an old scholar recalling his life, in a quiet room. Thin, dry, slightly raspy voice with a medium pitch and clear articulation.
